It includes:

- The harness-of-harnesses architecture and verified-run pattern.
- A capability-by-capability maturity and disposition assessment.

- Essential functionality to preserve and extend.
- Concrete compatibility/cruft candidates.

The central conclusion: DeadReckon’s defensible product is the combination of provider-neutral delegation, durable evidence, independent acceptance, recoverable isolation and deliberate promotion—not its breadth of commands or orchestration modes.
